sloka: प्रचारं स तु सङ्गृह्य प्रजास्वन्तर्गतः प्रभुः ।गुहां प्रविष्टः स्वसुतं शिशुमादाय मारुतः ।। ७.३५.४९ ॥
transliteration: pracāraṁ sa tu saṅgṛhya prajāsvantargataḥ prabhuḥ ।guhāṁ praviṣṭaḥ svasutaṁ śiśumādāya mārutaḥ ।। 7.35.49 ॥

translations.english: The lord Vayu, having withdrawn his circulation from among all creatures, took his child and entered a cave.
